title: An ask typed on the waiting page reaches its writer, and the owner can send several in a row
why: Owner report, Nov 2 12:55 CST, Home waiting page: an ask sent 11:55 CST still read 'Waiting for home-triage-4 to read it.' an hour later, and the owner can add only one ask before Send. Owner: 'the triage-r doesn't even seem to read custom asks'.
note:
Nov 6 11:51 CST (coordinator audit, Explore sonnet; PR head reachable from origin/main): DONE, done check met on main.
Find first, unmeasured. Read: the page tells Claude through one comment (page.html notifyClaude, sendToClaude), which wakes only the session that watches the artifact; the writer otherwise reads asks/ only at a wake or turn start (waiting-page SKILL.md). Likely: after a triage rotation the new writer holds no watch, so nothing wakes it; or canTell was false and the hint said so. Fix the cause: a new writer subscribes to its page at start, and the hint says plainly when no session was told. The one-at-a-time limit: find what blocks a second ask in renderAskForm or sendAsk, and let the owner queue several. Red first: an ask sent after a rotation wakes the new writer in a fixture; two asks typed back to back both save. Port: yes, the page and skill are shared. Ready. Lane report-guard-slice-2 session_013NEJL3dNLxnmdt942Ffipw, started by the coordinator Nov 3 17:26 CST (batch 2); slice 2 also takes audit row pr1108-fixes.
